title: Lightning 2.0 - `ImportError: cannot import name 'Schema' from 'pydantic'`
body:
### Bug description

When importing lightning with the new 2.0 release, I get the following error

```
ImportError: cannot import name 'Schema' from 'pydantic'
```

### How to reproduce the bug

```python
import lightning
```

cc @participant10

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: This looks like a Pydantic issue, a temp fix will be to downgrade pydantic using `pip install 'pydantic<1.8.0'`.
